name: Monke Happy
summary:
Monke Happy is an awesome Gorilla Tag fangame that offers a lot of exciting gamemodes and maps for you to release your true monke.

Customize your gameplay with an array of free mods. Platforms, fly, and more!

Test your speed in the Rising Lava mode. Lava rises and slowly engulfs the map.

Break the laws of physics in the Zero Gravity mode. Have fun as you float through the air.

Personalize your monke with a few items available in the in-game shop.

Feel the spook in the Horror mode, with a creepy environ
